name: forgejo-mcp
description: Connects to a forgejo-mcp server hosted at https://<host>/mcp on a self-hosted Forgejo instance, sending your access token as the Authorization header; prompts for the host and a token kept in secure storage.

forgejo_host.title: Forgejo host
forgejo_host.description: Hostname of your Forgejo instance that serves forgejo-mcp at /mcp, without scheme or path, for example git.example.com

forgejo_token.title: Forgejo access token
forgejo_token.description: Access token from Settings > Applications on your instance. Grant the least scope the work needs; read-only use needs only read scopes.
